# Code of conduct

Hallmark follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/). It applies to every issue, pull request, review and comment in this repository, and anywhere you speak for the project.

In practice, be patient and kind, especially with someone opening their first issue. Keep criticism about the code and the design. Harassment, insults, personal attacks and unwelcome sexual attention are never acceptable here.

## Reporting a problem

To report a comment, issue or pull request, open its **...** menu and choose **Report content**. GitHub's staff review those reports.

To tell the maintainers directly, reach [@Nutlope](https://github.com/Nutlope) or [@Luffixos](https://github.com/Luffixos) through the contact links on their GitHub profiles. We keep every report private.

## What maintainers can do

Maintainers may edit, hide or delete comments, lock a conversation, close an issue or pull request, and block someone from the repository, following the Covenant's section on addressing and repairing harm.
